answer_1.quote: We propose an approach for generating an implicit premise given a incomplete argument that aims to address these two challenges.

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU, one of the most widely used automatic metrics for generation tasks to compute BLEU-1 and BLEU-2 scores between the system output and the human written gold implicit premise. We also report F1-Score of BERTScore, a metric for evaluating text generation using contextualized embeddings.

answer_4.quote: We hired crowdworkers on the Amazon Mechanical Turk platform. Given an enthymemes they were asked if the generated implicit premises were plausible or not
answer_4.guideline: judge if the generated implicit premise is plausible or not
